title: Cap on bed and breakfast homes on Molokaʻi
summary: Bill 84, which caps bed and breakfast homes on Molokaʻi at five, passed 9–0 on July 7, 2026. An earlier version of the proposal would also have kept such homes 1,000 feet apart. The limit was first sent to the Molokaʻi Planning Commission for review in October 2025.
